review_candidates.title: Associate Analyst, Networking
review_candidates.description: The Network Operations team helps keep the company’s global network reliable, secure, and available for stores, corporate offices, distribution centers, and business partners. In this role, you will support day-to-day network operations by monitoring network health, assisting with incident troubleshooting, maintaining network equipment, supporting software and firmware updates, maintaining documentation, supporting approved changes, and helping validate updates in the local QA environment before they are released to production. This role works closely with Network Engineering and other technology teams to support Juniper-based network platforms, wireless services, firewalls, WAN connectivity, and related infrastructure that enable critical business operations. This job is located at our Global Home Office in Columbus, Ohio. What will you be doing? Monitor enterprise network health and performance across Juniper-based platforms, wireless services, firewalls, WAN circuits, and related infrastructure; identify alerts, service degradation, and potential business impact. Perform initial triage for network incidents by gathering logs, reviewing monitoring data, validating symptoms, and escalating issues to senior Network Operations, Network Engineering, carriers, or vendors when needed. Assist with troubleshooting connectivity, latency, packet loss, routing, switching, wireless, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall issues across stores, corporate offices, distribution centers, cloud environments, and partner connections. Support incident and problem management processes by documenting timelines, troubleshooting steps, findings, corrective actions, and follow-up items in the appropriate ticketing and knowledge systems. Assist with maintaining network equipment, performing approved software and firmware updates, completing lifecycle maintenance activities, and validating changes while following established change management, security, and compliance procedures. Maintain and support the local QA environment by helping validate network configurations, monitoring policies, automation updates, and operational procedures before production release. Track equipment health, support replacement or refresh activities, and help ensure network devices remain current, supportable, and aligned with operational standards. Keep network documentation current, including device inventories, circuit details, support procedures, escalation paths, diagrams, and knowledge articles. Collaborate with Network Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, application teams, carriers, and vendors to support timely issue resolution and service restoration. Identify recurring issues, monitoring gaps, or process improvement opportunities and share recommendations with senior team members. Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical incidents, after-hours maintenance, and urgent service restoration activities. What will you need to bring? 4-year degree in an IT-related field or equivalent work history. 2+ years of experience in IT operations, network support, infrastructure support, service desk escalation, or a related technical support environment. Foundational understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless, DNS, DHCP, VPN, NAT, firewall fundamentals, and Juniper Junos OS concepts. Experience using network troubleshooting tools and commands such as ping, traceroute, nslookup, packet capture tools, log review, monitoring dashboards, Junos CLI, Juniper Mist dashboards, Service Level Expectations, and Marvis insights. Familiarity with enterprise network technologies such as Juniper EX Series switches, Juniper SRX Series firewalls and gateways, Juniper Mist wireless access points, Mist AI, Marvis Virtual Network Assistant, Junos OS, routers, switches, wireless controllers, firewalls, load balancers, WAN circuits, and cloud connectivity. Ability to analyze alerts, logs, performance data, and incident trends to support effective troubleshooting and problem resolution. Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues, business impact, and resolution progress to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to prioritize work, remain calm during high-impact incidents, follow documented procedures, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced operational environment Benefits & Perks As an Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) associate, you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A&F is committed to providing simple, competitive, and comprehensive benefits that align with our Company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward: Incentive bonus program 401(K) savings plan with company match Annual companywide review process Flexible spending accounts Medical, dental, and vision insurance Life and disability insurance Associate assistance program Paid parental and adoption leave Access to fertility and adoption benefits through Carrot Access to mental health and wellness app, Headspace Paid Caregiver Leave Mobile Stipend Paid time off & one paid volunteer day per year, allowing you to give back to your community Work from anywhere (Mondays and Fridays are “work from anywhere” days for most roles & six work from anywhere weeks per year) Seven associate wellness half days per year Onsite fitness center Merchandise discount on all of our brands Opportunities for career advancement, we believe in promoting from within Access to multiple Associate Resource Groups Global team of people who will celebrate you for being YOU!

The successful candidate will lead the development of system architectures, requirements models, interface definitions, and digital engineering artifacts using Cameo Systems Modeler and SysML. The position will work closely with program managers, chief engineers, and technical teams to capture, model, and maintain complex system architectures across multiple products and development efforts. This position is based in Columbus, Ohio and supports a growing portfolio of advanced technology programs spanning communications, sensing, electronic warfare, autonomy, and software-defined systems. Develop and maintain system architectures, operational concepts, requirements models, interface definitions, and system behavior models. Establish and manage digital engineering frameworks supporting multiple products and programs. Create system models that provide traceability from customer needs and requirements through architecture, design, verification, and validation. Support development of digital engineering strategies and MBSE best practices across the organization. Maintain model consistency, configuration control, and technical baselines across evolving product lines. Facilitate model-based technical reviews and architecture assessments. Systems Architecture & Design Translate customer needs, mission objectives, and operational concepts into structured system architectures. Perform system-level trade studies and architectural analyses to evaluate technical alternatives. Define system decomposition, interfaces, and functional allocations across hardware, software, firmware, and communications subsystems. Support architecture development throughout the full lifecycle from concept through deployment and sustainment. Contribute to major engineering reviews including SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and SVR. Support integration between Cameo, requirements management tools, and other engineering repositories.
